COMMERCE · CASE STUDY

Delightful seller experiences in an agentic world

A three-part series on agents for marketplace sellers — cohorts, workflows and why chat isn’t the strategy.

The problem

Consumer assistants are booming. Where is the agent that helps a marketplace seller actually scale their business?

Thought process

Chat is a natural starting point but not the final form. Doing work for sellers needs high confidence, clear explanations and the right medium for each task.

The solution

Pick seller work that spans many functions and departments, understand each cohort’s habits and what they care about, then decide per action whether to ask in chat, show it visually, or simply do it and explain afterwards.
